purpose: This thin wrapper centralizes discovery and read-only access calls that otherwise would be imported from several EO modules. Most functions pass through unchanged; role-scoped capability lookup composes registry metadata with capability entries.
summary: Provides one in-process surface for skills, MCP status, capabilities, introspection, role scope, and task data.
